sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A mathematics background equivalent to the K-State bachelor’s curriculum is expected. A UChicago
mathematics bachelor’s is an appropriate degree route, subject to graduate committee, head and Graduate
School approval; this is an eligibility inference, not an admission prediction. International applicants are
explicitly eligible. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Create the graduate application; upload transcripts, résumé and academic-objectives statement; enter three
referees and request a TA if desired. Financial support documentation is for immigration processing after
admission, not an academic selection criterion. [s2] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor agreement is listed. Kim Klinger-Logan explicitly invites prospective graduate students
interested in working with her to email kklingerlogan@ksu.edu. General application questions:
math@math.ksu.edu. [s1] [s9]
Portal workflow [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
October 2026 department updates and September 2026 funding update are current pages, but dates are
recurring and not explicitly labeled Fall 2027. Recheck before submission. [s1] [s2] [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Admission accepts TOEFL, IELTS or PTE; not Duolingo or TOEFL ITP. Published minima are TOEFL 79 (4.5 on the
revised scale), IELTS 6.5 or PTE 58. Teaching has a separate speaking requirement: SPEAK 50, TOEFL speaking
22/revised 4.5, or IELTS speaking 7. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A received U.S. degree exempts the admission English test. The page does not expressly extend this to an
unfinished UChicago degree. The separate TA speaking requirement applies to nonnative English speakers
regardless of citizenship; do not assume the admission waiver satisfies teaching certification. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE scores are optional; the current instructions do not differentiate General and Mathematics Subject tests.
Copies may be used in review; official reporting institution code 6334, mathematics 0703. [s2]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload transcripts from every institution, including unofficial copies for review; foreign records require English
translations and degree certificates as applicable. Do not substitute mailed or emailed records for portal
uploads. Official copies are requested later. [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]

whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters; enter names and email addresses. Department says no separate letter form. [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Donoghue scholarship nomination may add $5,000 annually for two PhD years; no separate applicant essay or
extra reference is specified. International eligibility for this scholarship is not explicit. Preliminary-exam, Master
GTA, organizational-assistant and departmental awards may add compensation; summer funding is
conditional. NSF schemes advertised on the page require separate citizenship checks and should not be
treated as available to an F-1 applicant. [s3]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Central instructions say referees are automatically contacted after contact information is entered and
completed recommendations are added to the application. Exact save/submit button behavior is not specified.
[s4]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
The public instructions do not establish whether an invitation can be deferred until application submission;
obtain referee consent before entering details. [s4]
Receipt confirmation; Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
GTA includes a nine-month salary and fall/spring tuition waiver; amount is supplied in the individual offer and is
not published on the funding page. Summer salary requires summer GTA appointment. Application instructions
also describe resident fees and affordable health insurance, not a promise of all fees or full insurance payment.
[s2] [s3]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
International eligibility; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
International students may hold GTAs; teaching speaking certification is separate. GTAs teach recitations and
grade examinations. The offer controls exact financial terms; continuation duration is not established here. [s2]
[s3]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Request assistantship consideration within the main application. Donoghue scholarships are selected by
departmental nomination from the applicant pool. [s2] [s3]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Donoghue scholarship nomination may add $5,000 annually for two PhD years; no separate applicant essay or
extra reference is specified. International eligibility for this scholarship is not explicit. Preliminary-exam, Master
GTA, organizational-assistant and departmental awards may add compensation; summer funding is
conditional. NSF schemes advertised on the page require separate citizenship checks and should not be
treated as available to an F-1 applicant. [s3]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International degree application: USD 75; domestic fee USD 65. Pay on submission. [s2] [s4]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate School does not issue waiver codes. Departments may have limited competitive codes: ask

mathematics before paying. McNair waiver is implemented in the application if eligible. UChicago attendance
itself is not a published waiver category. [s4]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Rina Anno
Derived and DG categories, quotient stacks, geometric representation theory. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · The Hochschild homology of a noncommutative symmetric quotient stack
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Gabriel Kerr
Tropical and symplectic geometry, homological mirror symmetry. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2023 preprint · Painted Tropical Complexes
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Yan Soibelman
Higgs-bundle moduli, motivic invariants, wall crossing and categorical geometry. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Motivic invariants of moduli stacks of Higgs bundles and bundles with connections: results
and speculations
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Lino Amorim
Mirror symmetry and categorical enumerative invariants; symplectic side. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2024 publication · Ungraded matrix factorizations as mirrors of non-orientable Lagrangians
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Representation theory
Zongzhu Lin
Algebraic groups, quantum groups and differential graded/vertex algebras. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 online; 2027 issue · Differential graded algebras with divided powers and homotopy Lie algebras
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Geometric representation theory and algebraic combinatorics, flag-variety K-theory. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.

Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Vertex operators, symmetric functions and integrable structures. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · Generating functions of W₁₊∞ action on symmetric functions
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Vertex operator algebras, modular forms, lattices and finite groups. [s5] [s6]

Research evidence: 2025 preprint · The Order of the Monster Finite Simple Group
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written

Pay attention to
• The live deadline differs from a retained search-index extract.
• An English admission exemption does not remove TA speaking certification.
• Funding page gives no stipend amount or guarantee length.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A mathematics background equivalent to the K-State bachelor’s curriculum is expected. A UChicago
mathematics bachelor’s is an appropriate degree route, subject to graduate committee, head and Graduate
School approval; this is an eligibility inference, not an admission prediction. International applicants are
explicitly eligible. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Create the graduate application; upload transcripts, résumé and academic-objectives statement; enter three
referees and request a TA if desired. Financial support documentation is for immigration processing after
admission, not an academic selection criterion. [s2] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor agreement is listed. Kim Klinger-Logan explicitly invites prospective graduate students
interested in working with her to email kklingerlogan@ksu.edu. General application questions:
math@math.ksu.edu. [s1] [s9]
Portal workflow [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
October 2026 department updates and September 2026 funding update are current pages, but dates are
recurring and not explicitly labeled Fall 2027. Recheck before submission. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Funding consideration [Conflict]
Fall only. The live department page, updated October 28, 2026, gives February 1 for full consideration and
review thereafter until positions fill. Central international deadline is also February 1. No time zone is
published. A search-index version retained January 8 for international students: seek confirmation and use
January 8 as a conservative planning target, not a verified current deadline. [s1] [s4]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Aim for a complete file by the February 1 full-consideration date. No distinct letter, score or
supporting-document grace period is published. Official transcripts are requested later or with the offer. [s1] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Admission accepts TOEFL, IELTS or PTE; not Duolingo or TOEFL ITP. Published minima are TOEFL 79 (4.5 on the
revised scale), IELTS 6.5 or PTE 58. Teaching has a separate speaking requirement: SPEAK 50, TOEFL speaking
22/revised 4.5, or IELTS speaking 7. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A received U.S. degree exempts the admission English test. The page does not expressly extend this to an
unfinished UChicago degree. The separate TA speaking requirement applies to nonnative English speakers
regardless of citizenship; do not assume the admission waiver satisfies teaching certification. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE scores are optional; the current instructions do not differentiate General and Mathematics Subject tests.
Copies may be used in review; official reporting institution code 6334, mathematics 0703. [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload transcripts from every institution, including unofficial copies for review; foreign records require English
translations and degree certificates as applicable. Do not substitute mailed or emailed records for portal
uploads. Official copies are requested later. [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s2]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters; enter names and email addresses. Department says no separate letter form. [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Donoghue scholarship nomination may add $5,000 annually for two PhD years; no separate applicant essay or
extra reference is specified. International eligibility for this scholarship is not explicit. Preliminary-exam, Master
GTA, organizational-assistant and departmental awards may add compensation; summer funding is
conditional. NSF schemes advertised on the page require separate citizenship checks and should not be
treated as available to an F-1 applicant. [s3]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Central instructions say referees are automatically contacted after contact information is entered and
completed recommendations are added to the application. Exact save/submit button behavior is not specified.
[s4]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
The public instructions do not establish whether an invitation can be deferred until application submission;
obtain referee consent before entering details. [s4]
Receipt confirmation; Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Résumé required as an uploaded application document. No public length, typography or file-format rule. [s2]
Statement of purpose; Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Academic-objectives statement required, maximum two pages. Prompt paraphrase: explain enthusiasm for
mathematics, research interests and academic goals, relevant teaching or research experience, and optionally
faculty fit. Upload in application; font, spacing and file type not specified publicly. [s2]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Publications list; Course-list document; Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s2]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Donoghue scholarship nomination may add $5,000 annually for two PhD years; no separate applicant essay or
extra reference is specified. International eligibility for this scholarship is not explicit. Preliminary-exam, Master
GTA, organizational-assistant and departmental awards may add compensation; summer funding is
conditional. NSF schemes advertised on the page require separate citizenship checks and should not be
treated as available to an F-1 applicant. [s3]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
GTA includes a nine-month salary and fall/spring tuition waiver; amount is supplied in the individual offer and is
not published on the funding page. Summer salary requires summer GTA appointment. Application instructions
also describe resident fees and affordable health insurance, not a promise of all fees or full insurance payment.
[s2] [s3]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
International eligibility; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
International students may hold GTAs; teaching speaking certification is separate. GTAs teach recitations and
grade examinations. The offer controls exact financial terms; continuation duration is not established here. [s2]
[s3]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Request assistantship consideration within the main application. Donoghue scholarships are selected by
departmental nomination from the applicant pool. [s2] [s3]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Donoghue scholarship nomination may add $5,000 annually for two PhD years; no separate applicant essay or
extra reference is specified. International eligibility for this scholarship is not explicit. Preliminary-exam, Master
GTA, organizational-assistant and departmental awards may add compensation; summer funding is
conditional. NSF schemes advertised on the page require separate citizenship checks and should not be
treated as available to an F-1 applicant. [s3]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International degree application: USD 75; domestic fee USD 65. Pay on submission. [s2] [s4]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate School does not issue waiver codes. Departments may have limited competitive codes: ask

mathematics before paying. McNair waiver is implemented in the application if eligible. UChicago attendance
itself is not a published waiver category. [s4]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Search-index international deadline January 8 differs from the live February 1 rule. Central funding-affidavit
timing is after admission, while departmental instructions discuss it within application preparation. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm the international deadline, in-progress degree English waiver, exact stipend and guaranteed years,
commitment date, letter receipt display/update/reuse, scholarship citizenship eligibility and portal-only
formatting. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
